verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS AI app builder, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows that Lovable runs as a hosted service ('Lovable hosts your app', 'nothing to install'). The export, Git sync and 'deploy outside Lovable' options cover the generated app's code, not the Lovable builder itself, and nothing in the pack documents a self-hosted or on-prem version of the core product.
